model: SV21 / SV23 / SV25 Air Quality Sensors
applies_to: Verkada SV21, SV23 and SV25 indoor air quality and environmental sensors (BACnet is not available on other SV models).
summary: Verkada SV21, SV23 and SV25 sensors can act as BACnet IP smart sensors once BACnet is enabled in Verkada Command. Each exposes Analog Inputs at fixed instances for temperature, humidity, CO2 and derived indices; the SV23 and SV25 add particulates, TVOC, noise, motion, vape and AQI values, and the SV25 adds CO, light, pressure and formaldehyde.
notes: From the BACnet PICS table on Verkada's help page "Configure BACnet on Air Quality Sensors" (an HTML page, not a PDF).
The Supported Models column shows which sensors carry each object; an SV21 only has the objects marked SV21.
The device object name is the sensor serial number. All objects are read-only (DS-RP-B only).

source.title: Configure BACnet on Air Quality Sensors (Verkada Help Center)

integration.summary: Enable BACnet in Verkada Command, give each sensor a device ID, then poll the AIs that exist on your model, typically temperature, humidity and CO2, plus PM2.5 and TVOC on the SV23/SV25.
integration.enable: Enable Sensor BACnet under Admin > Feature Manager in Verkada Command, then enable BACnet on each sensor under its settings.
setup: Assign each sensor a unique BACnet device ID (0-4194302) in Verkada Command.
BACnet IP UDP port defaults to 47808 and can be set from 47808 to 47823.
Segmentation is not supported and the device profile is B-SS (read property only).
gotchas: Temperature, heat index and dew point are in °C only.
Check the Supported Models column: an SV21 carries far fewer objects than an SV25.
